scope: Published IRQ interface, recorded polling snapshot, and host-compiled IRQ candidate; hardware delivery unqualified

ack_sequence: read live MISC 0xa4 again, write value & ~0x10

measured_polling_sample.inference: This successful polling snapshot does not establish IRQ delivery. It does not identify why the IRQ done bit was clear.

implementation_requirements: Claim the DT IRQ with IRQF_NO_AUTOEN; leave it disabled during probe and whenever clocks are unavailable.
Synchronize and disable IRQ handling before reset/restore/power release; retain existing private-DMA stop proof and fencing.
Attribute delivery to the currently armed hardware command and reject stale or unexpected events.
Require a real completion event for successful normal decode; record event count and the raw pre-ack status.
Retain bounded detection of fatal CABAC syntax stalls; they need not produce a successful done IRQ.
Re-read the live acknowledge word between the two writes, preserving unrelated state.
Bound unexpected or repeated IRQ deliveries after acknowledge and mask the line on a storm. A sticky status bit alone is not proof that the GIC line remains asserted.
Preserve exact pixel comparisons, malformed-input rejection, concurrent contexts, stop/guards, unload and supervised recovery.

candidate_behavior.immediate_masking: IRQ_DISABLE_UNLAZY; line masked on first delivery
candidate_behavior.positive_completion: Exactly one nonunexpected done event attributed to the submitted command, followed by existing picture/error/last-MB/stop/guard checks
candidate_behavior.stale_event_rejection: Reject live done status before arming; an event before hardware submission fails without issuing the picture start
candidate_behavior.power_lifetime: Disable and synchronize handlers before reset, restore, suspend or release; fatal stop failure retains DMA and power with the IRQ masked
candidate_behavior.fatal_syntax_detection: Bounded CABAC alignment error check remains; picture-complete polling cannot produce success

native_polarity_acceptance_20261011.change: Complete the native INTPOL write by reading the same word under the existing raw lock. Compare only the requested IRQ polarity bit; mismatch unlocks, emits a rate-limited hwirq-only error and returns -EIO before GIC parent setup. BIT() avoids the signed bit-31 shift.
native_polarity_acceptance_20261011.remaining_work: Qualify the decoder SPI240 setup through a supervised exact-kernel module bind. Then use the existing request test with a truthful single-grey selector to observe one independently verified compressed grey picture under the current ACTIVE-clear CCF backend, which prior 7.2 IRQ trials did not submit. Retain real event, command attribution, pixels, stop/guards and terminal recovery; do not alias grey as PCM, accept a harness input error, or promote polling to IRQ completion. The exact source assertion contract and production decoder integration remain unfinished.

irq_trial_scope_20261011.trials_82_86_89_90_97: Each submitted only the first pcm64 picture; the harness exited on its failed capture metadata before compressed test commands.
irq_trial_scope_20261011.trial_23_variant_5: Compressed grey64 I_16x16 DC was actually submitted in IRQ mode, with all6144 private samples correct, zero IRQs and -110. Retained frame.flat selects grey64_nal.
irq_trial_scope_20261011.polling_trials_66_67: Exact retained engine reads MISC0xa4 after picture-complete polling and before stop, core reset or cleanup ACK. The sampled0x3001 is pre-cleanup but is not continuous source observation.
irq_trial_scope_20261011.implication: Missing IRQ delivery is not established for all codecs/cases, but the older compressed-grey observation rules out treating it as solely the first PCM fixture or solely the7.2 rebase.
irq_trial_scope_20261011.next_changed_scope: Historical compressed-grey IRQ failure23 had clock guard0x111, while ACTIVE-clear0x101 trial97 submitted onlyPCM. The existing request test now has a truthful --single grey64 selector using the original independently verified20-byte fixture and normal controls.
